description: Put a question for the person on the call's Decision Board (shown as #number with buttons; the person can also answer by voice, also freely). Meant for every question the person decides: yes/no, A/B, an approval, picking a value. A question only spoken via say leaves no button and no decision event. Without options it is a yes/no question (buttons Yes/No); options: 2 to 3, max 40 characters each, recommend = index of the recommended option. question: max 160 characters. Longer or more: 422, never cut. Returns id and number. The answer arrives later as a `next` event {type: decision, id, number, verdict: yes|no|option|other|unclear, option?, text? (their own answer, or for unclear the request to ask it again more simply), by}. Always pass context: 2 to 4 plain sentences the person does not see but Delta uses to explain the question (what it is about, why, what happens on yes, what on no), and faq: the 3 likely follow-up questions with prepared answers. Without context and 3 faq the result carries `warnings` (no error). Change an open one with id plus new fields, remove it with id and delete true.

q.description: A likely follow-up question of the person, max 200 chars.

context.title: Context

faq.description: Up to 3 likely follow-up questions with prepared answers [{q, a}] (max 200 chars each), hidden, for the voicebot. Without context and 3 faq the result carries `warnings`.
faq.title: Faq

id.title: Id

options.description: Optional: 2 to 3 answer options, max 40 characters each; leave out for a yes/no question.
options.title: Options

question.title: Question
